Use of AI in Recruiting 


We use artificial intelligence and other automated tools to assist with certain aspects of our recruiting process, including reviewing applications and supporting candidate evaluation. For example, we use Greenhouse's AI-powered Talent Matching tool to compare information in your application against job-related qualifications and criteria established by our recruiting team. More information about Greenhouse, including about its features and its Privacy Policy, may be found at its website. These tools assist our recruiting team and do not make hiring decisions.
